action_items.detail: When testing started, an orphaned process (PPID 1, started 03:04, not the supervisor's frontend) was already listening on :8080. It was left over from an earlier production simulation and returned 500 on /health. I stopped it (pids 6489/6933/6934) and started a fresh sim, which returned 200. After a run, stop the sim processes so a stale build never answers on a spare port.

The existing e1_tests/test_tscheck_newsletter_contact_excel.py imports openpyxl, which is not installed in this pod, so it fails at collection and stops the whole suite. I ran the rest of the suite with --ignore for that file. The full suite is also long (more than 280 s, because of the email tests). The phase-5 file, test_tscheck_public_openapi.py and test_tscheck_manage.py all passed (9 tests).

To get past the known Black Friday popup (out of scope), the booking and contact checks inject CSS that hides [data-slot=black-friday-promo-popup]. Without it, the popup blocks clicks on 'Gestionar o reprogramar mi cita' after a booking.

The CMS check edits the description of the seeded page_faq page and republishes it. The check then restores the original text and republishes again; restore was confirmed in Mongo. On its first run the restore assertion was too loose, so the marker text stayed published for about a minute until the corrected rerun restored it. The pageContent version and revision history now include tscheck revisions.

checks.criterion: JRN-68/76, JRN-70/84, JRN-73, JRN-74 (Next.js alone in production sim; API served directly; cron auth; DB down)
checks.name: backend/e1_tests/test_tscheck_p5_nextjs_standalone.py
checks.evidence: Sim on :8080 started with `PORT=8080 NODE_ENV=production yarn start` and the frontend/.env vars exported. GET /health returned 200 {"status":"ok"} after 588 ms; GET / returned 200 in 0.2 s with a server-rendered <h1>. Only next-server listened on 8080. backend/server.py is a relay only: its docstring says it never starts Next.js, and it has no subprocess or Popen. GET :8080/api/openapi.json returned 200, and GET /api/v1/bookings/availability returned 200 with slots. POST /api/internal/jobs returned 200 with Bearer CRON_SECRET, 200 with Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET (same value in both .env files), and 401 {"error":"No autorizado"} with no token. DB-down sim on :8090 (MONGO_URL pointing to unreachable 10.255.255.1:27999): /health returned 200, and availability returned 503 {"error":"Base de datos no disponible temporalmente."} with no stack trace. Both sims were stopped afterwards; the shared mongod and supervisor were not touched. 4 tests passed.

checks.criterion: JRN-78 contact/newsletter/admin regression + JRN-79/83 public pages
checks.name: contact-newsletter-admin-cms-publish
checks.evidence: Contact form showed its success status. Footer newsletter subscribe returned 2xx with 'Si la dirección es válida, recibirás un correo de verificación...'. owner@espacioq.test logged in at /acceso and was redirected to /admin. In /admin/contenido/page_faq I appended a tscheck marker and published ('Publicado (versión N)'); the marker then appeared on /preguntas-frecuentes, after which the original was restored and republished. The first run failed because my script filled the form before hydration; it passed after adding a hydration wait, so this was a script issue, not an app bug.
